title: Jassa Singh’s Wounds Rally the Sikh Chiefs and Charat Singh Charges Forward

blocks.text: News spreads that Full twenty two wounds did Jassa Singh receive, yet he still remains in the fight. The report shocks the assembled Sikh chiefs, but the shock quickly hardens into resolve as leaders from several contingents prepare to answer the crisis together.

The chiefs declare that none of them should think of survival without first meeting the enemy head-on. Their shared determination gives the page a collective tone: Jassa Singh's suffering becomes a rallying point that binds the misls more tightly in the middle of the Ghallughara.

Out of that resolve, Charat Singh rides forward searching for Abdali's line and crashing into the Gilja fighters with sword, spear, and gun. The page closes on renewed offensive spirit, showing the Sikh chiefs turning grief and alarm into a fiercer counterattack.
